title: Engine Oil — Introduction of the Requalified Filter Housing and Its Revised Heat Shield
abstract: Introduction of the oil filter housing requalified on the replacement casting alloy, together with the revised heat shield and clamp kit that its different thermal expansion makes necessary.

sections.planning_reason: The foundry that produced the original oil filter housing casting closed with no transfer of the pattern equipment, and the replacement source cannot reproduce the original alloy to the qualified process. The housing has been requalified on a different aluminium alloy with a higher coefficient of thermal expansion, which moves the housing relative to its heat shield by nearly two millimetres across the operating range. The original clearances do not allow for that movement, so the heat shield and the clamp kit change with the housing.
sections.description: The requalified housing is installed with the revised clamp kit D7920122286375, which has a longer slot at the aft attachment, and the inboard mount link D7920124662661 is shimmed at assembly. The heat shield PED599919-30 is replaced by an item with a larger relief around the filter bowl and the forward clamp ZED715928-89 is renewed. Plain washers EN229783-6C are used at every mount position. The cowl latch CAD307983-03 at the access panel is unchanged.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the fan cowl doors and make the engine safe for maintenance. Drain the oil system to the level given in the servicing instruction. Release the cowl latch CAD307983-03 and get access to the filter housing. Remove the forward clamp ZED715928-89 and the heat shield PED599919-30. Remove the housing using the removal task AMM-T-79-20-12-000-002-A. Install the requalified housing with the revised clamp kit D7920122286375, shimming the inboard mount link D7920124662661 to the clearance given in the accomplishment instructions. Fit the revised heat shield and the new forward clamp, using plain washers EN229783-6C at every mount position. Torque all fasteners to the values in the installation task AMM-T-79-20-12-400-002-A. Replenish the oil system and do a ground run to the idle condition. Do a leak check with the cowl doors open and confirm the heat shield clearance with the engine hot. Record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to TTN-88W1 and TTN-88W2 aircraft with the Auran installation, from MSN T00003 to MSN T00203. Aircraft from MSN T00206 onwards were built with the requalified housing. Accomplishment happens naturally as housings are consumed from spares; a fleet campaign is not required.
sections.material_note: Kit K7920-1006-01 covers one engine. Kit lead time is fifty-eight weeks and is driven by the casting supply, so operators wanting a uniform fleet standard should order well ahead. The requalified housing must never be installed with the original heat shield; this is called out as a caution in the installation task.

type_data.compliance_time: On consumption of the existing housing stock, or at operator convenience.
